no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held. The clinical trial designs and efficacy endpoints for radiopharmaceutical imaging drugs that target βamyloid were established at meetings of the Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee held on October 23, 2008 and on January 20, 2011. The Applicant followed this established regulatory path for the efficacy studies of flutemetamol F 18.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the Vizamyl (flutemetamol F 18) application NDA203137. The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Medical Review all state that no AC meeting was held or necessary for this NDA; the Medical Review states plainly that 'An advisory committee was not convened for this NDA.' Earlier class-wide Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee meetings (October 23, 2008 and January 20, 2011) established the trial-design and efficacy-endpoint path for amyloid imaging agents, which the applicant followed, but those meetings were not convened to discuss approval considerations for this specific application and are not tied to any application-specific change.
